## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Scoped change with no unrelated refactors
- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run coverage` passes
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high` reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] No secrets, logs, coverage output, or generated dependency folders committed
- [ ] No unrelated dependency changes
- [ ] API compatibility, security, cache, concurrency, and rate-limit impact considered

## Notes

Add reviewer context, limitations, or follow-up work.
